question: Does an independently indexed primary herbarium record support a source-described locality association between the Palicpican River research lead and Ternate, without assigning the full river route?
method: Reviewed the Naturalis Bioportal catalog record for herbarium sheet L.4175587, checked the specimen text against the official Cavite profile naming a portion of Palicpican River, and cross-checked Ternate’s PSA municipality code. Used only the specimen’s textual locality, not its displayed coordinates. Added one source-described locality association; did not infer route geometry, exclusive containment, fish presence, access, or fishing rules.
sourceRows: Naturalis L.4175587: Jasminum herbarium sheet; collected 1996-07-13 by Gaerlan, Fuentes, and Romero; locality text describes Mt. Palaypalay/Mataas na Gulod National Park, Sitio Malauyas, Barangay Sapang, Ternate, and travel/collection along Palicpican River.

Cavite Socio-Economic and Physical Profile 2014, Chapter 3, printed page 28: names a portion of Palicpican River in protected-landscape restoration and habitat-management zones; does not identify municipality or route.
PSA CALABARZON municipalities directory: Ternate municipality code 0402121000; locality crosswalk only, no waterbody or boundary geometry.

localityAssessment.sourceLocality: One botanical collection locality along Palicpican River, Barangay Sapang, Ternate, Cavite, within the Mt. Palaypalay/Mataas na Gulod protected-landscape context.

specimen.collector: Gaerlan, FJM; Fuentes, RE; Romero, EM

localityAssessment.coordinateHandling: Naturalis displays one site coordinate pair for the botanical specimen. It was not used as river geometry, a route point, or a boundary crosswalk.
localityAssessment.interpretation: The locality string supports a historical collection-site association with a Palicpican River reach in Ternate. It does not locate all reaches or the river mouth/source.

assignments.sourcePage: Naturalis Bioportal record L.4175587, Locality field; Cavite SEPP 2014 Chapter 3, printed p.28; PSA CALABARZON municipality directory, Ternate row.
assignments.sourceRow: Naturalis specimen L.4175587: Barangay Sapang, Ternate; along Palicpican River. PSA code: 0402121000.
assignments.sourceLocality: Historical botanical collection site along Palicpican River, Barangay Sapang, Ternate, Cavite.
assignments.limit: One historical collecting locality/segment only. The full channel location, municipality/province crossings, route geometry, outlet, fish evidence, access, safety, and current regulations remain unresolved.

nonClaims: No fish species, occurrence, abundance, or current-presence claim was added; the specimen is botanical.
No river route, catchment, shoreline, protected-area boundary, salinity class, or coordinate was added to the app.
Ternate is a source-described locality for one historic specimen locality along the named river, not proof that the whole channel lies in Ternate.
No fishing access, safety, legal restriction, or seasonal condition was determined.
Naturalis record metadata are CC0 1.0; the specimen image or other multimedia was not reused.
decision: Add Ternate as one municipality-coded, source-described locality for the Palicpican River research lead. Keep geometry, full-channel attribution, and fish evidence unresolved; do not admit public application content.
nextAction: Continue source-backed locality review for Mamba/Cacabay, Bucal (Lalangnan), and Labayat; search for route-scale official hydrography and site-resolved fish surveys for Palicpican and other inland-water leads. Keep scopeFrozen=false.
